title: Outlook: folders and shared mailboxes stay expanded or collapsed after a restart
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap details and product licensing match the sources, and searches found no documented control for remembering folder expansion. One descriptive assurance should be narrowed: the roadmap describes a display change but does not explicitly guarantee that the feature takes no action on mail.
